title: Fellowship
definition: Fellowship is the shared life believers have with God and one another through union with Christ and the indwelling Holy Spirit.
summary: Biblical fellowship is deeper than social connection. It includes shared faith, mutual care, prayer, encouragement, correction, service, and partnership in the Gospel.
christFocus: Because believers are united to Christ, they are joined to one another. Fellowship becomes a visible witness of His love and grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Fellowship begins with life in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It is expressed through shared worship, care, truth, and mission.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Faithful fellowship strengthens discipleship and protects against isolation.
